words.en: Feudalism is a social system that existed in Europe during the Middle Ages in which people worked and fought for nobles who gave them protection and the use of land in return.

words.ex: He eats fiber to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃纤维来保持健康。
words.en: A fiber is a thread or a structure or object resembling a thread, especially one that is used to make cloth or rope.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.ex: The light bulb has a thin filament.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡有一根细灯丝。
words.en: A filament is a very thin thread or fiber of natural or artificial material.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.tr: n. 滤液；滤气; v. 过滤；筛选
words.ex: The filtrate is then collected in a separate container.
words.ex_cn: 滤液随后被收集在单独的容器中。
words.en: Filtrate is a liquid that has passed through a filter.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.ex: The book has a finite number of pages.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的页数是有限的。
words.en: Something that is finite has a definite fixed size or extent.

words.tr:
n. 火；
v. 射击；开火；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 火在壁炉里熊熊燃烧。
words.en: Fire is the heat and light that comes out when something burns. It can also refer to the act of shooting a weapon or the dismissal of an employee from a job.

words.ex: The amoeba reproduces by fission.
words.ex_cn: 阿米巴通过分裂生殖进行繁殖。
words.en: Fission is the splitting of an atomic nucleus, resulting in the release of a large amount of energy.

words.ex: The flaw in the glass made it break easily.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃上的瑕疵让它很容易碎。
words.en: A flaw is a mistake or weakness in something that makes it less effective or valuable.

words.ex: The navy launched a large fleet to protect the coast.
words.ex_cn: 海军派出了一支大型舰队来保护海岸。
words.en: A fleet is a group of ships or vehicles that are controlled by one company or organization and are used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The company values flexibility in work hours.
words.ex_cn: 公司重视工作时间的灵活性。
words.en: Flexibility refers to the quality of bending easily without breaking, or the ability to be easily modified to respond to altered circumstances or conditions.

words.ex: Ancient people used flint to make fire.
words.ex_cn: 古人用燧石生火。
words.en: Flint is a very hard greyish-black stone that was used in former times for making tools and weapons, and for starting fires.

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: The forest has rich flora with many wild flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有丰富的植物，有许多野花。
words.en: The plants of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 流动；
words.ex: The flow of water in the river is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 河里水的流动非常快。
words.en: To move along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

words.tr: n. 开花时节；鼎盛时期；
words.ex: The flowering of cherry trees happens in spring.
words.ex_cn: 樱花的开花时节在春天。
words.en: The process or period of producing flowers; the state of being in bloom.

words.ex: The price of oil fluctuates every day.
words.ex_cn: 油价每天都在波动。
words.en: To fluctuate means to change or vary frequently and unpredictably.

words.ex: The stock market shows daily fluctuation.
words.ex_cn: 股票市场每天都有波动。
words.en: A fluctuation is a change in something, especially in a continuous process such as temperature, prices, or levels of activity.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.tr:
n. 流体；流质；
adj. 流动的；
words.ex: Water is a common fluid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的流体。
words.en: A fluid is a substance that can flow and change its shape easily, such as a liquid or a gas.

words.tr:
n. 流量；流动；变动
v. 熔化；熔解；流出
words.ex: The flux of water through the pipe is very high.
words.ex_cn: 管道中水的流量非常高。
words.en: Flux is a state of constant change or a flow of liquid.

words.ex: The car drove slowly through the fog.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓缓驶过浓雾。
words.en: Fog is a thick cloud of tiny water droplets suspended in the atmosphere at or near the earth's surface which obscures or restricts visibility (to a greater extent than mist; strictly, reducing visibility to below 1 km).

words.ex: The trees showed bright foliage in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 秋天时，树木呈现出鲜艳的叶子。
words.en: The leaves of a plant or tree, or the leaves on trees and plants collectively.

words.ex: Gorillas are primarily folivores, feeding on leaves and stems.
words.ex_cn: 大猩猩主要是食叶动物，以树叶和茎为食。
words.en: An animal that feeds on leaves.

words.tr:
v. 搜寻；（动物）觅食；
n. 饲料；草料；
words.ex: The bear forages for berries in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只熊在森林里搜寻浆果。
words.en: If you forage, you search for food or other supplies. Forage can also refer to food for animals, especially when it is grown or collected.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.ex: He loves eating foreign food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃什么外国食物。
words.en: belonging to or connected with a country that is not your own

words.tr:
adj. 最重要的；
adv. 首要地；
words.ex: He is the foremost expert in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的专家。
words.en: Most important or prominent; leading.

words.ex: The formation of clouds happens when water vapor cools.
words.ex_cn: 云的形成发生在水蒸气冷却时。
words.en: The process of forming or making something, or the way something is formed or made.

words.ex: The storm was formidable and destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴很可怕，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as formidable, you mean that you feel slightly frightened by them because they are very great or impressive.

words.ex: The teacher will formulate a new rule for class.
words.ex_cn: 老师将制定一条新的课堂规则。
words.en: If you formulate something such as a plan or proposal, you invent it, thinking about the details carefully.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
words.en: A fossil is the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.tr: v. （使）成化石；变陈腐；（使）僵化
words.ex: The old tree fossilized over millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 这棵老树在数百万年中变成了化石。
words.en: To fossilize means to become or cause to become a fossil, or to become fixed and unable to change or develop.

words.ex: Parents should foster good habits in children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该培养孩子的好习惯。
words.en: To foster something means to encourage and promote its development.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.ex: He fractured his arm during the soccer game.
words.ex_cn: 他在足球比赛中摔断了手臂。
words.en: If something such as a bone fractures or is fractured, it breaks or cracks.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: The glass broke into small fragments.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃碎成了小碎片。
words.en: A fragment of something is a small piece or part of it.

words.ex: The fragmentation of the market makes it hard to control.
words.ex_cn: 市场的碎片化使得它难以控制。
words.en: The process or state of breaking or being broken into small or separate parts.

words.ex: There is friction between the two neighbors over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居因为篱笆问题产生了不和。
words.en: The resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

words.ex: The fringe of the forest is full of wildflowers.
words.ex_cn: 森林的边缘长满了野花。
words.en: The outer, marginal, or extreme part of an area, group, or sphere of activity.

words.ex: There was frost on the grass this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上草地上有霜。
words.en: A thin layer of ice that forms on surfaces when the temperature drops below freezing.

words.ex: He is frugal with his money.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱很节俭。
words.en: If you describe someone as frugal, you mean that they are careful about spending money and use things only when they need to.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: He worked hard to fulfill his dream.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的梦想。
words.en: To fulfill a task, role, or function means to do or perform it as required or expected.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 霉菌；菌类；真菌；“fungus”的复数；
words.ex: The bread has fungi growing on it.
words.ex_cn: 面包上长了霉菌。
words.en: Fungi are a group of living organisms which are classified in their own kingdom. This means they are not animals, plants, or bacteria. Fungi include mushrooms, molds, and yeasts.

words.ex: The fungus grows on old trees.
words.ex_cn: 真菌生长在老树上。
words.en: A fungus is a simple type of plant that has no leaves or flowers and that grows on plants or decaying matter.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；配备；供给；提供
words.ex: He will furnish the apartment with new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 他将为公寓配备新家具。
words.en: To furnish a place means to put furniture and other things into it.

words.ex: The fusion of music and technology creates new sounds.
words.ex_cn: 音乐与技术的融合创造了新的声音。
words.en: The process or result of joining two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.ex: The galactic center is very far from Earth.
words.ex_cn: 银河系中心离地球非常远。
words.en: Relating to a galaxy or galaxies, especially the Milky Way galaxy.

words.ex: The Milky Way is our home galaxy.
words.ex_cn: 银河系是我们所在的星系。
words.en: A galaxy is an extremely large group of stars and planets that extends over many billions of light years.

words.ex: Gametes are reproductive cells that fuse during sexual reproduction.
words.ex_cn: 配子是性繁殖过程中融合的生殖细胞。
words.en: A gamete is a mature haploid male or female germ cell that is able to unite with another of the opposite sex in sexual reproduction to form a zygote.

words.tr: n. 差距；隔阂；缺口；缝隙；
words.ex: There is a big gap between rich and poor.
words.ex_cn: 富人和穷人之间有很大的差距。
words.en: A gap is a space between two things or a hole in the middle of something solid.

words.tr: n. 气体；气态；汽油；天然气；煤气；
words.ex: Oxygen is a gas that we need to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 氧气是一种我们呼吸所需的气体。
words.en: Gas is a substance like air that is neither liquid nor solid and burns easily. It is used as a fuel for cooking and heating.

words.ex: The gas is in a gaseous state.
words.ex_cn: 这种气体处于气态。
words.en: Relating to or having the characteristics of a gas.

words.tr: n. 测量仪器；规格；评估；
words.ex: The mechanic used a gauge to check the tire pressure.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用一个测量仪器来检查轮胎气压。
words.en: A gauge is a device that measures the amount or quantity of something and shows the measurement in a form that is easy to read, such as a dial or a digital display.

words.ex: He has a gene that makes him tall.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个让他长高的基因。
words.en: A gene is the basic physical and functional unit of heredity. Genes, which are made up of DNA, act as instructions to make molecules called proteins.

words.tr: n. 家谱学；系谱学；宗谱学；家谱（图）
words.ex: He is learning his family genealogy.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习自己的家族家谱。
words.en: Genealogy is the study of the history of families and the line of descent from their ancestors.

words.tr: n. （有多方面知识和经验的）通才；多面手
words.ex: He is a generalist who works in many areas.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位涉猎多个领域的人。
words.en: A generalist is a person who knows a lot about many different subjects, rather than specializing in one particular subject.

words.ex: The wind generates electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风产生电力。
words.en: To generate something means to cause it to begin and develop.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.ex: He bought a generic brand of painkiller.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一种普通的止痛药品牌。
words.en: Generic refers to something that is not specific or unique, often used to describe products that are not branded or are general in nature.

words.ex: The scientist studied genetic traits in plants.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了植物的基因特征。
words.en: relating to genes or heredity

words.ex: Dogs show genetic variation in fur color.
words.ex_cn: 狗的毛色存在遗传变异。
words.en: Genetic variation refers to the diversity in gene frequencies within a population. It can refer to differences between individuals or to differences between populations. Mutation, gene flow, and sexual reproduction are sources of genetic variation.

words.ex: Scientists mapped the human genome last year.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们去年绘制了人类基因组。
words.en: The complete set of genes or genetic material present in a cell or organism.

words.ex: The lion belongs to the genus Panthera.
words.ex_cn: 狮子属于豹属。
words.en: A genus is a class of things which have common characteristics and which can be divided into subordinate kinds.

words.ex: The rock shows geochemical changes over time.
words.ex_cn: 这块岩石随着时间显示出地球化学变化。
words.en: Relating to the chemistry of the earth and its rocks and minerals.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.tr: adj. 地质学的；地质上的；
words.ex: The geological layers show the history of the Earth.
words.ex_cn: 这些地质层展示了地球的历史。
words.en: Relating to the study of the Earth's physical structure and substance, its history, and the processes that act on it.

words.ex: He loves studying geology in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在高中学习地质学。
words.en: The science which deals with the physical structure and substance of the earth, their history, and the processes which act on them.

words.ex: He draws triangles in geometry class.
words.ex_cn: 他在几何课上画三角形。
words.en: Geometry is the branch of mathematics concerned with the properties and relations of points, lines, surfaces, solids, and higher dimensional analogs.

words.ex: The geomorphic features of the area were shaped by centuries of erosion.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区的地貌特征是由几个世纪的侵蚀塑造的。
words.en: Relating to the form of the landscape and other natural features of the earth's surface.

words.ex: The town uses geothermal energy to heat homes.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇利用地热能为房屋供暖。
words.en: Geothermal refers to the heat that comes from the sub-surface of the earth. It is contained in the rocks and fluids beneath the earth's crust and can be found as far down as to the earth's hot molten rock, magma.

words.ex: The germination of the seed took five days.
words.ex_cn: 这颗种子的萌芽花了五天时间。
words.en: The process by which a seed begins to grow and develop into a new plant.

words.ex: He made a gesture of welcome with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手做了一个欢迎的姿态。
words.en: A gesture is a movement that you make with a part of your body, especially your hands, to express emotion or information.

words.ex: The glacial landscape was covered in snow.
words.ex_cn: 冰河地貌被雪覆盖着。
words.en: relating to, resulting from, or denoting the presence or agency of ice, especially in the form of glaciers.

words.ex: The glacier moves slowly down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 冰川缓慢地沿着山向下移动。
words.en: A glacier is a large, persistent body of ice that forms where the accumulation of snow exceeds its ablation over many years, often centuries.

words.tr:
v. 上釉；上玻璃；浇浆汁于；变呆滞
n. 釉料；光滑面；覆罩的一层
words.ex: The potter glazes the clay bowl before firing it.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠在烧制前给陶碗上釉。
words.en: To glaze means to fit panes of glass into a window frame or similar structure. It can also refer to the process of applying a glossy, often transparent, coating to pottery or other materials.

words.ex: The problem is a global issue.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题是一个全球性的问题。
words.en: relating to the whole world; worldwide

words.ex: Global warming is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 全球变暖正在让地球变得更热。
words.en: Global warming refers to the long-term increase in Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.

words.ex: The doctor checked his glucose level.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的血糖水平。
words.en: A simple sugar which is an important energy source in living organisms and is a component of many carbohydrates.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs were a form of glyph.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及的象形文字是一种字形。
words.en: A glyph is a symbol or a character that is used in writing or printing, especially in ancient writing systems.

words.tr: n. 倾斜度；坡度；梯度；斜坡
words.ex: The hill has a steep gradient.
words.ex_cn: 这座山有一个陡峭的坡度。
words.en: A gradient is a slope or a degree of inclination, especially in a road or railway.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: Farmers grow grain like wheat and rice.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植小麦和大米等谷物。
words.en: A grain is a small, hard seed of a food plant such as wheat, rice, or corn, or the plant itself.

words.ex: The table is made of granite.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是花岗岩做的。
words.en: Granite is a very hard rock that is often used in building.

words.ex: He drew a graph to show the temperature changes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个图表来显示温度变化。
words.en: A graph is a mathematical diagram which shows the relationship between two or more sets of numbers or measurements.

words.ex: The report shows graphical data to explain trends.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告用图表数据来解释趋势。
words.en: Relating to or involving visual art or computer graphics.

words.ex: He uses graphite to draw pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他用石墨画画。
words.en: Graphite is a soft, black form of carbon that is used in pencils and as a lubricant.

words.ex: The cows graze on the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Grassland is a large open area of country covered with grass, especially one used for grazing.

words.ex: The apple fell because of gravitation.
words.ex_cn: 苹果掉下来是因为重力。
words.en: Gravitation is the force of attraction that exists between any two masses, any two bodies, any two particles. It is the force that pulls objects towards each other.

words.ex: The gravitational force pulls the apple to the ground.
words.ex_cn: 引力把苹果拉向地面。
words.en: relating to or resulting from the force of gravity

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.ex: The cows graze in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛每天早上在田野里吃草。
words.en: To graze means to feed on grass or to touch something lightly in passing.

words.ex: The greenhouse effect makes the Earth warmer.
words.ex_cn: 温室效应使地球变暖。
words.en: The greenhouse effect is the process by which radiation from a planet's atmosphere warms the planet's surface to a temperature above what it would be without its atmosphere.

words.tr: phrase. 温室气体；二氧化碳、甲烷等导致温室效应的气体
words.ex: Cars release greenhouse gas into the air.
words.ex_cn: 汽车向空气中排放温室气体。
words.en: A greenhouse gas is a gas that contributes to the greenhouse effect by absorbing infrared radiation, e.g., carbon dioxide and chlorofluorocarbons.

words.ex: The city improved its power grid to handle more electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改进了其电力输送网，以承载更多的电力。
words.en: A grid is a pattern of straight lines that cross each other to form squares. It is used to help you draw or to help you find places on a map.

words.ex: He grinds the coffee beans into powder.
words.ex_cn: 他把咖啡豆碾成粉末。
words.en: To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing it.

words.tr: n. （动物）梳毛； v. “groom”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cat spends hours on grooming its fur.
words.ex_cn: 猫花几个小时梳理自己的毛。
words.en: The activity of keeping yourself or your pet clean and tidy, especially by washing, brushing, and cutting hair.

words.ex: The nail fits into the groove.
words.ex_cn: 钉子卡在槽里。
words.en: A groove is a long, narrow space or cut in a surface, often made to guide the movement of something or to hold something in place. It can also refer to a settled routine or way of doing things that is hard to change.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地面上玩耍。
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.ex: The well draws water from groundwater.
words.ex_cn: 这口井从地下水取水。
words.en: Water that is located beneath the earth's surface in soil pore spaces and in the fractures of rock formations.

words.tr: phrase. 地面筑巢的；在地面筑巢的
words.ex: The ground-nesting bird hides its eggs in the grass.
words.ex_cn: 这种地面筑巢的鸟把蛋藏在草丛里。

words.tr:
n. 组；群；集团；
v. （使）形成组；
words.ex: The students are in a group of five.
words.ex_cn: 这些学生组成一个五人小组。
words.en: A group is a number of people or things that are located, gathered, or classed together.

words.tr: phrase. 生长期；作物生长季节
words.ex: The growing season lasts from spring to fall.
words.ex_cn: 生长季节从春天持续到秋天。
words.en: The period of the year during which the weather conditions are suitable for the growth of plants.

words.ex: The growth of the plant is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这植物在冬天生长缓慢。
words.en: The process of increasing in physical size, number, value, or strength.

words.tr:
v. 保证；确保；
n. 保证；保证书；
words.ex: The store guarantees a refund if you are not happy.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不满意，商店保证退款。
words.en: A guarantee is a formal promise that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially that a product will be repaired or replaced if it is not of a specified quality.

words.tr: n. 行会；同业公会；协会；
words.ex: The medieval guild controlled the price of bread.
words.ex_cn: 中世纪的行会控制了面包的价格。
words.en: A guild is an organization of people who do the same job or have the same interests.

words.ex: The Gulf of Mexico is a large sea area.
words.ex_cn: 墨西哥湾是一个大型海域。
words.en: A gulf is a large area of sea that is partly surrounded by land.

words.tr:
n. 一阵狂风；突然的一阵
v. （风）猛刮
words.ex: A sudden gust blew the hat off his head.
words.ex_cn: 一阵突然的风把他的帽子吹掉了。
words.en: A gust is a sudden, strong rush of wind.

words.ex: The doctor checked his gut for signs of infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的肠道是否有感染迹象。
words.en: The gut refers to the stomach and other internal organs of an animal or person, often used to describe the digestive tract. It can also metaphorically represent courage or determination.

words.ex: Pine trees are gymnosperms.
words.ex_cn: 松树是裸子植物。
words.en: A gymnosperm is a plant that has seeds unprotected by an ovary or fruit, typically conifers or related plants.

words.ex: The ocean currents form a large gyre in the North Atlantic.
words.ex_cn: n. 北大西洋的洋流形成了一个大环流。
words.en: A gyre is a large system of rotating ocean currents, particularly those involved with large wind movements.

words.ex: He has a habit of waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他有早起的习惯。
words.en: A habit is something that you do often or regularly.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.tr:
n. 发际线
adj. （裂缝、缝隙等）极细的；极细微的
words.ex: He has a thin hairline.
words.ex_cn: 他的发际线很细。
words.en: A hairline is the edge of a person's hair, especially at the front, or a very thin line.

words.ex: The hallmark of a good teacher is patience.
words.ex_cn: 好老师的标志是耐心。
words.en: A hallmark is a distinctive characteristic or attribute that is typical of a particular person or thing.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在大厅里集合。
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.tr: v. 妨碍，束缚，限制；妨碍，束缚，限制( hamper的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The heavy rain hampered our journey.
words.ex_cn: 大雨妨碍了我们的旅程。
words.en: Hindered or obstructed in progress or action.

words.tr:
adj. 单倍体的
n. 单倍体
words.ex: The haploid cell has one set of chromosomes.
words.ex_cn: 单倍体细胞有一套染色体。
words.en: A haploid cell or organism has a single set of unpaired chromosomes.

words.ex: The ship docked at the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbor is a place on the coast where ships may moor in shelter, especially one protected from rough water by piers, jetties, and other artificial structures.

words.tr: n. 坚硬；难度；艰难；冷酷
words.ex: The hardness of the rock surprised him.
words.ex_cn: 这块岩石的硬度让他感到惊讶。
words.en: The quality or condition of being hard.

words.tr: adj. 能吃苦耐劳的；耐寒的；
words.ex: He is a hardy farmer who works in the field all day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个能吃苦耐劳的农民，整天在田里干活。
words.en: Someone who is hardy is strong and able to cope with difficult conditions.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 马具；
words.ex: We must harness the power of the sun.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须利用太阳的能量。
words.en: A harness is a set of straps which fit under a person's arms and fasten round their body in order to keep a piece of equipment in place or to prevent the person moving from a place.

words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.ex: The chemicals are hazardous to health.
words.ex_cn: 这些化学物质对健康有危险。
words.en: Something that is hazardous is dangerous, especially to people's health or safety.

words.ex: The government wants to improve healthcare for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望为所有人改善医疗保健。
words.en: Healthcare refers to the organized provision of medical care to individuals or a community.

words.tr: n. 壁炉地面；炉床；炉边
words.ex: She sat by the hearth to keep warm.
words.ex_cn: 她坐在壁炉旁取暖。
words.en: The floor of a fireplace, often extending into a room and paved with brick, stone, or cement, used as a place to build fires or for sitting in front of a fire.

words.ex: His heart rate increased after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后心率加快了。
words.en: The number of times the heart beats per minute.

words.ex: Water has a high heat capacity.
words.ex_cn: 水具有很高的热容。

words.ex: The farmer used a heavy plow to till the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用重型犁耕地。

words.ex: My grandmother gave me the heirloom necklace.
words.ex_cn: 奶奶把这串祖传的项链给了我。
words.en: An heirloom is a valuable object that has belonged to a family for several generations.

words.ex: The heliocentric model shows planets orbiting the sun.
words.ex_cn: 日心说模型显示行星围绕太阳运行。
words.en: Having or representing the sun as the center, as in the accepted astronomical model of the solar system.

words.ex: The balloon is filled with helium.
words.ex_cn: 气球里充满了氦气。
words.en: Helium is a chemical element with the symbol He and atomic number 2. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless, non-toxic, inert, monatomic gas, the first in the noble gas group in the periodic table. Its boiling point is the lowest among all the elements.

words.ex: The DNA has a double helix shape.
words.ex_cn: DNA具有双螺旋形状。
words.en: A helix is a shape like a corkscrew or spiral staircase.

words.tr: adj. 希腊文化的；希腊化的
words.ex: The statue is in the Hellenistic style.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像具有希腊化风格。
words.en: Relating to Greek history, language, and culture from the death of Alexander the Great to the defeat of Cleopatra and Mark Antony by Octavian in 31 BC.

words.ex: The doctor checked his hemoglobin level.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的血红素水平。
words.en: Hemoglobin is the protein molecule in red blood cells that carries oxygen from the lungs to the body's tissues and returns carbon dioxide from the tissues back to the lungs.

words.ex: The Earth is divided into two hemispheres: north and south.
words.ex_cn: 地球被分为两个半球：北半球和南半球。
words.en: A hemisphere is one half of the earth, especially the northern or southern half above or below the equator, or the eastern or western half.

words.ex: The deer is a herbivore.
words.ex_cn: 鹿是食草动物。
words.en: An herbivore is an animal that gets its energy from eating plants, and only plants.

words.ex: He inherited his family's heritage.
words.ex_cn: 他继承了家族的遗产。
words.en: Heritage refers to the traditions, achievements, beliefs, etc., that are part of the history of a group or nation.

words.ex: Fungi are heterotrophs that depend on dead matter for food.
words.ex_cn: 真菌是异养生物，依赖死亡的有机物为食。
words.en: An organism that cannot synthesize its own food and is dependent on complex organic substances for nutrition.

words.tr:
adj. 启发式的；探索的
n. 启发式教学
words.ex: He uses a heuristic method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一种启发式方法来解决问题。
words.en: A heuristic is a method that helps you to learn or discover something for yourself, especially by making intelligent guesses rather than by following fixed rules.

words.tr: n. 十六进制；妖法；巫婆; vi. 施魔法; vt. 施魔法于
words.ex: She cast a hex on her enemies.
words.ex_cn: 她对她的敌人施了魔法。
words.en: 1. If you say that someone has put a hex on you, you mean that they have caused you to have bad luck by using magic. 2. To hex someone means to put a hex on them.

words.ex: Bears go into hibernation in winter.
words.ex_cn: 熊在冬天冬眠。
words.en: Hibernation is a state of inactivity and metabolic depression in endotherms during winter.

words.tr: n. 层次体系；等级制度；
words.ex: The company has a clear hierarchy from manager to worker.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个从经理到员工的明确层次体系。
words.en: A hierarchy is a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians used hieroglyph to write messages.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人用象形文字来书写信息。
words.en: A hieroglyph is a character of the ancient Egyptian writing system, which consists of pictures or symbols representing words or sounds.

words.tr:
v. 突出；强调；高光；
n. 最突出的部分；
words.ex: The teacher highlighted the key words in the text.
words.ex_cn: 老师把文中的关键词突出了。
words.en: To highlight something means to make it stand out or to emphasize it, often because it is important or interesting.

words.ex: The children played on the green hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在绿色的丘陵上玩耍。
words.en: A hill is a piece of land that is higher than the land that surrounds it, but not as high as a mountain.

words.ex: Rain can hinder our plan to go hiking.
words.ex_cn: 雨天会妨碍我们去徒步旅行的计划。
words.en: If something hinders you, it makes it more difficult for you to do something or make progress.

words.tr: n. 暗示；提示；有益的建议；
words.ex: He gave me a hint about the surprise party.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我关于惊喜派对的暗示。
words.en: A hint is a slight or indirect indication or suggestion.

words.ex: Histology is the study of the microscopic structure of tissues.
words.ex_cn: 组织学是研究组织显微结构的一门学科。
words.en: Histology is the study of the microscopic structure of tissues.

words.ex: The historian wrote a book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 这位历史学家写了一本关于古罗马的书。
words.en: A historian is a person who studies or writes about history; an expert in history.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.ex: The tree has a hollow trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的树干是中空的。
words.en: If something is hollow, it has an empty space inside it.

words.ex: The body maintains homeostasis to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 身体保持稳态以保持健康。
words.en: The ability or tendency of an organism or cell to maintain internal equilibrium by adjusting its physiological processes.

words.tr: n. 类人动物; adj. 人科动物的；似人类的
words.ex: The hominoid species are closely related to humans.
words.ex_cn: 类人动物与人类有着密切的关系。
words.en: A hominoid is any primate of the superfamily Hominoidea, which includes the great apes and humans.

words.ex: The mixture is homogeneous and looks the same throughout.
words.ex_cn: 这种混合物是均一的，看起来处处都一样。
words.en: Something that is homogeneous is uniform in nature or character throughout.

words.tr:
n. 蜂窝；蜂窝状物
v. 使布满小孔；成蜂窝状
words.ex: Bees build their nest in a honeycomb shape.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜂窝形状建造它们的巢。
words.en: A honeycomb is a structure of hexagonal cells made by bees, used to store honey and pollen or to house their eggs and larvae.

words.tr: n. 地平线；思想等的范围；眼界；
words.ex: The sun set below the horizon.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在地平线以下落山。
words.en: The horizon is the line at which the earth's surface and the sky appear to meet.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.ex: The horticulturist is designing a new garden layout.
words.ex_cn: 这位园艺学家正在设计一个新的花园布局。
words.en: A horticulturist is a person who studies or practises gardening and plant cultivation, especially professionally.

words.tr:
n. 主人；主持人；
v. 主持；
words.ex: The host welcomed us with tea and cookies.
words.ex_cn: 主人用茶和饼干欢迎了我们。
words.en: A host is a person who receives or entertains guests, especially in their own home. A host is also a person who presents a television or radio program.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.tr: n. 住房供给； v. 收容；“house”的现在分词；
words.ex: The city needs more housing for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为低收入家庭提供更多的住房供给。
words.en: Housing refers to buildings or other shelters in which people live; a place to live.

words.tr: adj. 人道的；仁慈的；人文的
words.ex: The shelter treats animals in a humane way.
words.ex_cn: 这个收容所以人道的方式对待动物。
words.en: If you describe something as humane, you mean that it is good and kind, especially because it decreases suffering.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.tr:
n. 跨栏；障碍；难关
v. 越过障碍；克服
words.ex: He jumped over the hurdle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跳过了跨栏。
words.en: A hurdle is a problem or difficulty that you must deal with before you can achieve something.

words.tr:
n. 杂交种；混合物；
adj. 混合的；
words.ex: The corn hybrid grows faster than the old type.
words.ex_cn: 这种玉米杂交种比旧品种长得更快。
words.en: A hybrid is a plant or animal that has been produced from two different types of plant or animal, especially to get better characteristics. It can also refer to something that is a mixture of two different things.

words.ex: The scientist studies hybridization between two plant species.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究两种植物之间的杂交。
words.en: The process of combining different varieties or species to create a hybrid.

words.ex: Drinking water helps with hydration.
words.ex_cn: 喝水有助于水合。
words.en: The process of causing something to absorb water.

words.tr: adj. 液压的；流体的；利用液体压力的；
words.ex: The hydraulic brake system stops the car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 液压制动系统能快速让汽车停下。
words.en: Hydraulic refers to the operation of machinery or systems by the movement and force of liquid, especially water or oil.

words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.tr: phrase. 水文循环；水循环（指水在地球表面、大气和地下之间的连续循环过程）
words.ex: The hydrological cycle is a continuous process that involves the movement of water between the Earth's surface and the atmosphere.
words.ex_cn: 水文循环是一个持续的过程，涉及水在地球表面和大气之间的运动。
words.en: The hydrological cycle, also known as the water cycle, is the continuous process by which water is circulated throughout the Earth and its atmosphere by evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and transpiration.

words.tr: phrase. 水热喷口；海底热泉，指在海底裂隙处喷出高温热液的地质结构
words.ex: Scientists have discovered new species of marine life around hydrothermal vents.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在热液喷口附近发现了新的海洋生物物种。
words.en: A hydrothermal vent is a fissure on the seafloor from which geothermally heated water issues.

words.ex: Good hygiene helps prevent sickness.
words.ex_cn: 良好的卫生有助于预防疾病。
words.en: Hygiene refers to conditions and practices that help to maintain health and prevent the spread of diseases.

words.tr: adj. 过敏的；易受冒犯的
words.ex: He is hypersensitive to pollen and gets sneezing easily.
words.ex_cn: 他对花粉过敏，容易打喷嚏。
words.en: If someone is hypersensitive, they are extremely sensitive to certain situations or to the behaviour of other people, often reacting in an exaggerated or extreme way.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.ex: It is a hypothetical situation.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个假设的情况。
words.en: A hypothetical situation, idea, or explanation is based on possible ideas or situations rather than actual ones.

words.tr: phrase. 冰芯；从冰盖或冰川中钻取的圆柱形冰样，用于研究古气候和环境变化
words.ex: Scientists drill ice core to study ancient climate.
words.ex_cn: 科学家钻取冰芯来研究古代气候。
words.en: A cylinder of ice extracted from a glacier or ice sheet, used for climate study.

words.ex: The two shirts are identical.
words.ex_cn: 这两件衬衫是一样的。
words.en: Exactly the same, or very similar.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.ex: He has ideological beliefs about freedom.
words.ex_cn: 他有关于自由的思想信念。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with ideas, especially of a political or economic nature.

words.tr: adj. 火成的；火的；似火的
words.ex: The rock is igneous because it came from lava.
words.ex_cn: 这块岩石是火成岩，因为它来自熔岩。
words.en: Igneous rocks are rocks formed by the cooling and solidification of magma or lava.

words.ex: He used a match to ignite the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他用火柴点燃了火。
words.en: If you ignite something or if it ignites, it starts burning or explodes.

words.ex: It is illegal to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 无证驾驶是非法的。
words.en: If something is illegal, the law says that it is not allowed.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.ex: The mirror creates an illusion of a bigger room.
words.ex_cn: 镜子制造出房间更大的错觉。
words.en: An illusion is a false idea or belief, especially about yourself or your situation.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.ex: Can you imagine a world without phones?
words.ex_cn: 你能想象一个没有电话的世界吗？
words.en: To imagine means to form a mental image or concept of something that is not present or real.

words.ex: The imbalance in income causes social problems.
words.ex_cn: 收入的失衡导致了社会问题。
words.en: An imbalance is a situation in which the elements or forces involved are not equal in strength or importance, leading to a lack of equilibrium.

words.ex: He immersed the cloth in water.
words.ex_cn: 他把布浸在水里。
words.en: To immerse something or someone means to put them into a liquid so that they are completely covered by it. It can also mean to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.ex: The immigrant found a job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移民在城市里找到了一份工作。
words.en: An immigrant is a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: Immigration to this country has increased recently.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的移民数量最近增加了。
words.en: Immigration is the act of coming to live permanently in a country that is not your own.

words.ex: The accident immobilized his leg.
words.ex_cn: 事故使他的腿无法动弹。
words.en: To prevent something or someone from moving or operating as normal.

words.tr: adj. 有免疫力的；免疫的；不受影响的；
words.ex: Children are immune to this disease after vaccination.
words.ex_cn: 儿童接种疫苗后对这种疾病有免疫力。
words.en: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it. If you are immune to something such as criticism, it does not affect you.

words.ex: The immune system fights germs in the body.
words.ex_cn: 免疫系统在体内对抗细菌。
words.en: The immune system is the body's defense against infectious organisms and other invaders. Through a series of steps called the immune response, the immune system attacks organisms and substances that invade body systems and cause disease.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: He imparts knowledge to his students every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天向学生传授知识。
words.en: If you impart information to people, you tell it to them. To impart a particular quality to something means to give it that quality.

words.ex: He is impatient when he waits for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他等公交车时很不耐烦。
words.en: If you are impatient, you are easily annoyed by delays or by people making mistakes.

words.ex: His speech impediment made it hard for him to talk clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他的口吃使他难以清晰地说话。
words.en: An impediment is something that makes it difficult to do or achieve something.

words.tr: adj. 感觉不到的；极细微的
words.ex: The change was imperceptible to the naked eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个变化肉眼无法察觉。
words.en: Something that is imperceptible is so small or slight that it cannot be seen or noticed.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.tr: n. 含意；可能的影响（或后果）；暗示；
words.ex: The implication of his words was that he was sorry.
words.ex_cn: 他话中的含意是他很抱歉。
words.en: An implication is a possible future effect or result of an action or decision, often one that is not immediately obvious.

words.ex: His silence was an implicit apology.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默是一种含蓄的道歉。
words.en: Something that is implicit is expressed in an indirect way.

words.ex: The government imposed a new tax on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府对糖征收了一项新税。
words.en: To impose means to officially force a rule, tax, punishment, etc. to be obeyed or received.

words.ex: The war impoverished many families.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争使许多家庭变得贫困。
words.en: To make someone poor or to reduce the quality, strength, or richness of something.

words.ex: He faced imprisonment for stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷钱而面临监禁。
words.en: The state of being confined in prison; the act of putting someone in prison or the condition of being kept in prison.

words.ex: It is improbable that he will arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 他准时到达的可能性很小。
words.en: If you describe something as improbable, you mean it is unlikely to be true or to happen.

words.tr: adj. 不适当的；不正当的；不成体统的
words.ex: Wearing shorts to the meeting is improper.
words.ex_cn: 穿短裤去开会是不适当的。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as improper, you mean that it is rude or shocking.

words.ex: He acted on impulse and bought the car.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动买了那辆车。
words.en: An impulse is a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking about the consequences.

words.tr: n. 不纯，不洁；杂质；不纯的东西
words.ex: The water has an impurity that makes it unsafe to drink.
words.ex_cn: 水中有一种杂质，使其不适合饮用。
words.en: An impurity is a substance of a different type that is mixed with another substance, often making it less pure.

words.tr: adj. 难以达到的；无法接近的；
words.ex: The mountain peak is inaccessible in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这座山峰在冬天难以到达。
words.en: If a place is inaccessible, it is very difficult or impossible to reach or enter.

words.tr: adj. 不精确的；不准确的；有错误的；
words.ex: The clock is inaccurate and shows the wrong time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟不精确，显示的时间不对。
words.en: If a statement or measurement is inaccurate, it is not correct or not exact.

words.tr: adj. 不活动的；不活跃的；怠惰的；
words.ex: The old man is inactive because of his illness.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人因为生病而不活动。
words.en: If someone or something is inactive, they are not doing anything or are not working.

words.ex: The food supply was inadequate for the number of people.
words.ex_cn: 食物供应对人数来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is inadequate, there is not enough of it or it is not good enough.

words.ex: The chair is inanimate.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是没有生命的。
words.en: Something that is inanimate is not alive, such as a rock or a chair. It can also describe something that lacks energy or spirit.

words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.ex: The cost of lunch was incidental to the main expense.
words.ex_cn: 午餐的费用是主要开销的附带部分。
words.en: If one thing is incidental to another, it is less important than the other thing or is not a major part of it.

words.tr: v. 焚化；焚毁；把…烧成灰烬
words.ex: The city will incinerate the trash tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市明天将焚烧垃圾。
words.en: To incinerate something means to burn it until it is reduced to ash.

words.ex: He has an inclination to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他有帮助他人的倾向。
words.en: An inclination is a feeling that makes you want to act in a particular way, or a tendency to do something.

words.tr: adj. 包容的；包含全部费用的；
words.ex: The school is inclusive and welcomes all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校是包容的，欢迎所有学生。
words.en: Inclusive is used to describe something that is designed to include all types of people, things, or ideas, and to treat them all fairly and equally.

words.ex: The small brown bird was inconspicuous among the trees.
words.ex_cn: 这只棕色的小鸟在树丛中不引人注目。
words.en: Something that is inconspicuous is not easily seen or noticed.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: The company made incremental progress each month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每个月都有增长的进展。
words.en: An incremental change or process happens gradually, often by a series of small additions.

words.tr: adj. 站不住脚的；不可辩解的；不能防卫的
words.ex: His excuse was indefensible.
words.ex_cn: 他的借口是无法辩护的。
words.en: If you say that something is indefensible, you mean that it cannot be justified or supported because it is completely wrong or unacceptable.

words.ex: The unemployment rate is an economic indicator.
words.ex_cn: 失业率是一个经济指标。
words.en: An indicator is a measurement or value which gives you an idea of what something is like.

words.ex: The indigenous people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 本土居民住在森林里。
words.en: Indigenous people or things belong to the country in which they are found, rather than coming there or being brought there from another country.

words.ex: Water is indispensable for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必不可少的。
words.en: Absolutely necessary or essential.

words.ex: The ad induced him to buy the product.
words.ex_cn: 这则广告诱使他购买了该产品。
words.en: To induce a state or condition means to cause it.

words.tr: adj. 诱导的；归纳的；感应的
words.ex: The scientist used inductive reasoning to form a hypothesis.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用归纳推理来形成一个假设。
words.en: Inductive reasoning involves making broad generalizations from specific observations.

words.ex: The industrial revolution changed how people made things.
words.ex_cn: 工业革命改变了人们制造东西的方式。
words.en: The Industrial Revolution was the transition to new manufacturing processes in the period from about 1760 to sometime between 1820 and 1840.

words.tr: adj. 不可避免的；必定的；
words.ex: It is inevitable that the sun will rise tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳明天一定会升起。
words.en: If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.ex: This product is inferior to the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这个产品比另一个差。
words.en: If one person or thing is inferior to another, they are not as good, important, or valuable as the other person or thing.

words.ex: The farm suffered from an infestation of insects.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场遭受了昆虫的侵袭。
words.en: An infestation is a large number of pests or parasites that have invaded a place and are causing harm.

words.ex: The universe may be infinite.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙可能是无限的。
words.en: If you describe something as infinite, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in amount or degree.

words.ex: The swollen area is inflammatory and painful.
words.ex_cn: 这个肿胀的部位是发炎的，并且很痛。
words.en: If you describe someone's language or behaviour as inflammatory, you mean that it is likely to cause people to react very angrily.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.ex: There was a large influx of tourists during the summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天期间涌入了大量游客。
words.en: An influx of people or things is a large number of them arriving somewhere at the same time.

words.tr:
adj. 红外线的
n. 红外线
words.ex: The remote uses infrared to change the TV channel.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器使用红外线来切换电视频道。
words.en: Infrared refers to the region of the electromagnetic spectrum with wavelengths longer than visible light but shorter than microwaves, often used in technology for night vision and heat sensing.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.ex: Honesty is an inherent quality of a good leader.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是好领导固有的品质。
words.en: Existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute.

words.ex: He inherited a house from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里继承了一所房子。
words.en: If you inherit something such as a trait, characteristic, or quality, you are born with it, because your parents or ancestors had it. If you inherit money or property, you receive it from someone who has died.

words.ex: He received his father's watch as an inheritance.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了父亲留给他的手表作为遗产。
words.en: Inheritance is money or property which you receive from someone who has died.

words.ex: The medicine helps inhibit pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物有助于抑制疼痛。
words.en: If something inhibits an event or process, it prevents it or slows it down.

words.tr: n. 倡议；主动权；自发性；措施；
words.ex: The school launched an initiative to reduce plastic use.
words.ex_cn: 学校发起了一项减少塑料使用的倡议。
words.en: An initiative is an important act or statement that is intended to solve a problem.

words.tr:
adj. 内陆的；
adv. 向内地；在内陆；
n. 内地；内陆；
words.ex: The small village is located inland, far from the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于内陆，远离大海。
words.en: Inland means situated in the interior of a country rather than on the coast.

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.ex: The inner core is very hot and made of solid iron.
words.ex_cn: 内核非常热，由固态铁组成。
words.en: The solid, innermost layer of Earth's core, primarily composed of iron and nickel.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.tr: adj. 革新的；富有革新精神的；
words.ex: The company made an innovative phone.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司推出了一款革新的手机。
words.en: Something that is innovative is new and original, especially in the way that it is done.

words.tr: adj. 无机的；非自然生长的
words.ex: The rock is inorganic.
words.ex_cn: 这块石头是无机的。
words.en: Inorganic substances or materials are not derived from living organisms and typically do not contain carbon.

words.tr:
n. 输入；
v. 输入；
words.ex: The computer needs user input to work.
words.ex_cn: 计算机需要用户输入才能工作。
words.en: Input is information that is put into a system or machine so that it can operate.

words.ex: The police opened an inquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An inquiry is a question which you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: He inscribes his name on the stone.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字刻在石头上。
words.en: To write, mark, or engrave (words, symbols, etc.) on a surface, especially as a formal or permanent record.

words.ex: The insect flew over the grass.
words.ex_cn: 那只昆虫飞过了草地。
words.en: An insect is a small animal that has six legs. Most insects have wings. Ants, flies, butterflies, and beetles are all insects.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不重要的；
words.ex: The mistake was insignificant and didn't affect the result.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误无关紧要，没有影响结果。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as insignificant, you mean that they are small or unimportant, and therefore not worth considering seriously.

words.ex: The insolation from the sun can cause skin damage.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的曝晒会导致皮肤损伤。
words.en: Insolation refers to the exposure to the sun's rays, especially as a therapeutic measure.

words.ex: The instability of the bridge made people afraid to cross it.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的不稳定让人们不敢过桥。
words.en: Instability is the state of being unstable, especially in a political or economic context, where it refers to a lack of stability or the tendency to change or fail suddenly.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.ex: The hospital is an institutional building.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一座大型机构的建筑。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of an institution, especially a large organization or public body.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.ex: The teacher gave clear instruction on how to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了如何解决这个问题的明确教授。
words.en: Detailed information telling how something should be done, operated, or assembled.

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.ex: The doctor checked his daily intake of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他每天的糖摄入量。
words.en: The process of taking something in, especially food, air, or information.

words.ex: The vase remained intact after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 花瓶从高处摔下后依然完整无缺。
words.en: Something that is intact is complete and has not been damaged or changed.

words.tr: adj. 综合的；整合的；融合的； v. 整合；结合；“integrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The school offers an integrated science course.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校提供一门综合科学课程。
words.en: An integrated system or approach combines different groups or ideas in a way that works well.

words.ex: The integration of technology and education improves learning.
words.ex_cn: 技术与教育的结合改善了学习。
words.en: The act or process of combining or adding parts to make a unified whole.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.ex: The intensity of the sunlight made me wear sunglasses.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的强度让我戴上了太阳镜。
words.en: The quality of being intense, especially in terms of concentration, power, or force.

words.ex: He took an intensive English course last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他参加了一个密集的英语课程。
words.en: Intensive is used to describe something that involves a lot of effort, energy, or attention in a short period of time.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.ex: The app has an interactive game for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有一个适合孩子的交互式游戏。
words.en: An interactive computer program or system is designed to involve the user in the exchange of information.

words.tr: adj. 各学科间的；跨学科的；
words.ex: The project is interdisciplinary, combining biology and chemistry.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是跨学科的，结合了生物学和化学。
words.en: Involving two or more academic, scientific, or artistic disciplines.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.ex: The interglacial period had warm weather and tall trees.
words.ex_cn: 间冰期气候温暖，树木高大。
words.en: An interglacial period is a geological interval of warmer global average temperature lasting thousands of years that separates consecutive glacial periods within an ice age.

words.tr:
n. 内部；
adj. 内部的；
words.ex: The interior of the house is very cozy.
words.ex_cn: 房子的内部非常舒适。
words.en: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.ex: The internal parts of the machine need repair.
words.ex_cn: 机器的内部零件需要修理。
words.en: Internal is used to describe things that exist or happen inside a particular person, object, or place.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.ex: He interrupted me while I was speaking.
words.ex_cn: 我在说话时他打断了我。
words.en: To interrupt someone means to stop them from speaking by saying or doing something, or to cause something to stop happening for a period of time.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.ex: The spaceship travels through interstellar space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙飞船在星际空间中航行。
words.en: Existing or occurring between stars.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.ex: The teacher intervened when the students argued.
words.ex_cn: 当学生们争吵时，老师进行了干涉。
words.en: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

words.ex: The teacher made an intervention to help the student.
words.ex_cn: 老师进行了干预以帮助学生。
words.en: Intervention is the act of intervening, especially in a situation to prevent something undesirable from happening.

words.ex: The doctor checked his intestinal health.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的肠道健康。
words.en: Relating to or affecting the intestines.

words.ex: They have an intimate friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着亲密的友谊。
words.en: having a close, friendly, or personal relationship with someone; private and personal

words.ex: He is intolerant of people who are late.
words.ex_cn: 他不能容忍迟到的人。
words.en: If you describe someone as intolerant, you mean that they do not accept behavior and opinions that are different from their own.

words.ex: The lock has an intricate design.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁有复杂的结构。
words.en: You use intricate to describe something that has many small parts or details.

words.tr: adj. 固有的；内在的；本身的；
words.ex: Honesty is an intrinsic part of her character.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是她性格中固有的部分。
words.en: belonging to a thing by its very nature

words.ex: The intrusion of strangers made her feel unsafe.
words.ex_cn: 陌生人的闯入让她感到不安全。
words.en: An intrusion is an unwanted event or person in a situation where they are not welcome or do not belong.

words.ex: I trusted my intuition and chose the right answer.
words.ex_cn: 我相信自己的直觉，选了正确的答案。
words.en: Intuition is the ability to understand or know something immediately, without the need for conscious reasoning.

words.ex: The army tried to invade the neighboring country.
words.ex_cn: 军队试图侵犯邻国。
words.en: To enter a country, town, or region by force in order to take control of it.

words.tr: adj. 不变的; n. [数] 不变量；[计] 不变式
words.ex: The speed of light is invariant in all frames.
words.ex_cn: 光速在所有参考系中都是不变的。
words.en: An invariant is something that does not change or is not affected by changes in other things.

words.ex: The invasive plant spreads quickly and kills other plants.
words.ex_cn: 这种侵入性植物生长迅速，会杀死其他植物。
words.en: If you describe something as invasive, you mean that it spreads very quickly and is difficult to stop.

words.ex: The inverse order of the numbers is 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的倒序是5、4、3、2、1。
words.en: If there is an inverse relationship between two things, one of them becomes larger as the other becomes smaller.

words.ex: The jellyfish is an invertebrate.
words.ex_cn: 水母是一种无脊椎动物。
words.en: An invertebrate is an animal that does not have a backbone or spinal column.

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: He invoked the law to protect his rights.
words.ex_cn: 他援引法律来保护自己的权利。
words.en: If you invoke a law, rule, or principle, you refer to it as a reason or justification for something.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.ex: He took iodine to help his thyroid.
words.ex_cn: 他服用碘来帮助他的甲状腺。
words.en: A chemical element of the halogen group, essential for the production of thyroid hormones.

words.ex: The ion moves quickly in the water.
words.ex_cn: 这个离子在水中快速移动。
words.en: An ion is an atom or molecule with a net electric charge due to the loss or gain of one or more electrons.

words.ex: His refusal to listen is irrational.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝倾听是不合理的。
words.en: If you describe someone's feelings and behavior as irrational, you mean they are not based on logical reasons or clear thinking.

words.ex: The shape has irregular sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状的边是不规则的。
words.en: Something that is irregular does not follow the expected pattern, plan, or method; it is not regular.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不相关的；
words.ex: His opinion is irrelevant to the decision.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见与这个决定无关紧要。
words.en: If you describe something as irrelevant, you mean that it is not important to or not connected with the present situation or discussion.

words.ex: The damage to the environment is irreversible.
words.ex_cn: 对环境的破坏是不可逆转的。
words.en: If a change is irreversible, it cannot be changed back to how it was before.

words.ex: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用灌溉来浇灌庄稼。
words.en: Irrigation is the process of supplying water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.ex: He lives on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个小岛上。
words.en: An island is a piece of land that is completely surrounded by water.

words.ex: The hospital will isolate the patient to stop the spread.
words.ex_cn: 医院将隔离这名病人以防止传播。
words.en: To isolate someone or something means to separate them from other people or things, often in order to protect them or to prevent the spread of something harmful.

words.ex: He felt isolation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到孤立。
words.en: The state of being in a place or situation that is separate from others

words.ex: This isotope is used in medical tests.
words.ex_cn: 这种同位素用于医学检查。
words.en: An isotope is one of two or more forms of the same chemical element. Different isotopes of an element have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons in their nuclei.

words.ex: The scientist uses isotopic samples to study ancient climates.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用同位素样本研究古代气候。
words.en: Relating to or having the same atomic number but different atomic weights.

words.ex: We planned our itinerary before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们在旅行前规划了路线。
words.en: An itinerary is a plan of a journey, including the route and the places that you will visit.

words.tr: n. 象牙；象牙色 adj. 象牙色的
words.ex: The old piano has ivory keys.
words.ex_cn: 这架旧钢琴有象牙键。
words.en: Ivory is a hard, white material from the tusks and teeth of animals, which is used to make or decorate objects.

words.ex: He used too much jargon in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中用了太多行话。
words.en: Special words or expressions that are used by a particular profession or group and are difficult for others to understand.

words.tr:
adj. 联合的；共同的；
n. 关节；接合处；
words.ex: They signed a joint agreement to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一项联合协议来保护环境。
words.en: A joint is a place where two things are joined together, especially the place where two bones are connected in a person's or animal's body.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.tr: adj. 司法的；法庭的；审判的；
words.ex: The judicial system protects people's rights.
words.ex_cn: 司法系统保护人民的权利。
words.en: Judicial means relating to the legal system and to judgments made in a court of law.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.ex: The lion lives in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 狮子生活在丛林中。
words.en: A jungle is a dense, tropical forest that is home to a wide variety of plants and animals.

words.tr: n. 管辖权；司法权；裁判权；
words.ex: The court has jurisdiction over this case.
words.ex_cn: 法院对这个案件有管辖权。
words.en: The official power to make legal decisions and judgments.

words.ex: He tried to justify his mistake by saying he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他试图以自己累了为由来证明自己的错误是正当的。
words.en: To justify something means to show or prove that it is reasonable, necessary, or correct.

words.tr:
adj. 青少年的；幼稚的；
n. 少年；
words.ex: The book is written for juvenile readers.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是为青少年读者撰写的。
words.en: A juvenile is a child or young person who is not yet old enough to be considered an adult.

words.ex: He juxtaposes old photos with new ones.
words.ex_cn: 他把老照片和新照片放在一起。
words.en: To place or deal with close together for contrasting effect.

words.tr: adj. 渴望的；热心的；敏锐的；
words.ex: He is keen to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望学习英语。
words.en: If you are keen on doing something, you very much want to do it. If you are keen that something should happen, you very much want it to happen.

words.ex: Kelp grows in cold ocean water.
words.ex_cn: 大型褐藻生长在寒冷的海洋水中。
words.en: Kelp is a type of large brown seaweed that grows in the sea, especially in cold water.

words.ex: He drank water to help his kidney work better.
words.ex_cn: 他喝水以帮助肾脏更好地工作。
words.en: One of the two organs in your lower back that separate waste products from your blood and make urine.

words.ex: The potter fired the clay in a kiln.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把陶土放在窑里烧制。
words.en: A kiln is a type of oven that is used to bake clay and pottery in order to make them hard.

words.ex: She invited all her kin to the family reunion.
words.ex_cn: 她邀请了所有亲属参加家庭聚会。
words.en: Your kin are your relatives.

words.ex: The kinetic energy of the moving ball is high.
words.ex_cn: 运动的球的动能很高。
words.en: Relating to or resulting from motion.

words.ex: The kinetic energy of the moving car can be converted to other forms of energy.
words.ex_cn: 运动中的汽车的动能可以转化为其他形式的能量。
words.en: Kinetic energy is the energy that a body possesses by virtue of being in motion.

words.ex: He has a knack for fixing bikes.
words.ex_cn: 他有修自行车的技巧。
words.en: A knack is a special skill or ability that someone has, especially one that is hard to explain or teach.

words.ex: He kneads dough every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上揉面团。
words.en: To knead is to press and stretch dough or another substance with your hands in order to make it smooth and ready to use.

words.ex: He tied a knot in the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他在绳子上打了一个结。
words.en: A knot is a fastening made by tying a piece of string, rope, or something similar. It can also refer to a hard mass formed in a tree trunk at the intersection with a branch, or a unit of speed equal to one nautical mile per hour, used especially by ships and aircraft.

words.ex: He is knowledgeable about history and science.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史和科学都很博学。
words.en: Someone who is knowledgeable has or shows a clear understanding of many different facts about the world or about a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.tr: n. 劳动；体力劳动；劳工；
words.ex: Hard labor helps build strong character.
words.ex_cn: 辛勤的劳动有助于培养坚强的品格。
words.en: Work, especially physical work; to work hard.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.tr: n. 迷宫；难解的事件；错综复杂；
words.ex: The child got lost in the labyrinth.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在迷宫里迷路了。
words.en: A labyrinth is a complicated irregular network of passages or paths in which it is difficult to find one's way; a maze.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.ex: He takes lactase to digest milk.
words.ex_cn: 他服用乳糖酶来消化牛奶。
words.en: An enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolysis of lactose to glucose and galactose.

words.ex: The truck is laden with boxes.
words.ex_cn: 这辆卡车装满了箱子。
words.en: If someone or something is laden with a lot of heavy things, they are holding or carrying them.

words.ex: The children swam in the clear lagoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在清澈的潟湖里游泳。
words.en: A lagoon is a body of water separated from larger bodies of water by a natural barrier such as a sandbar, coral reef, or barrier island.

words.ex: The children play by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖边玩耍。
words.en: A large area of water surrounded by land.

words.ex: She lamented the death of her dog.
words.ex_cn: 她哀悼她狗的去世。
words.en: If you lament something, you express your sadness, regret, or disappointment about it.

words.ex: The water moves in laminar flow through the pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水在管道中以层流形式流动。

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.tr: n. 山崩；塌方；压倒性的胜利
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a landslide.
words.ex_cn: 大雨引发了山体滑坡。
words.en: A landslide is a victory in an election in which a person or political party gets far more votes or seats than their opponents.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.ex: His lapse in judgment caused the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他的疏忽导致了事故。
words.en: A lapse is a temporary failure or a slight error, or the process by which something gradually passes into a different state, especially a worse one.

words.ex: The caterpillars are the larvae of butterflies.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫是蝴蝶的幼虫。
words.en: Larvae are the immature, wingless, and often wormlike feeding form that hatches from the egg of many insects, alters chiefly in size while passing through several molts, and is finally transformed into a pupa or chrysalis from which the adult emerges.

words.ex: The larynx helps us speak and breathe.
words.ex_cn: 喉部帮助我们说话和呼吸。
words.en: The part of the throat that contains the vocal cords and is used for breathing, swallowing, and speaking.

words.ex: The doctor used a laser to fix her eye.
words.ex_cn: 医生用激光修复了她的眼睛。
words.en: A laser is a device that emits light through a process of optical amplification based on the stimulated emission of electromagnetic radiation.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；恒久的； v. 持续；“last”的现在分词；
words.ex: The friendship between them is lasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的友谊是持久的。
words.en: Something that is lasting continues to exist or have an effect for a very long time.

words.ex: The latent talent in the child became clear after years of practice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子潜在的才能在多年练习后显现出来。
words.en: Latent is used to describe something which is hidden and not obvious at the moment, but which may develop further in the future.

words.ex: The car made a lateral move to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 汽车横向移动以避开狗。
words.en: Relating to the side or sides; situated at or extending to the side.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: The volcano spilled hot lava down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷出炽热的岩浆流下山。
words.en: Lava is the molten rock that comes out of a volcano during an eruption.

words.ex: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。
words.en: A layer of a substance or material is a quantity or piece of it that covers a surface or that is between two other things.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.tr: adj. 最重要的；一流的；处于领导地位的； v. “lead”的现在分词；带领；领导；
words.ex: He is the leading scientist in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的科学家。
words.en: If something is leading in a particular area, it is the most important or advanced thing in that area.

words.ex: The green leaf fell from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 绿叶从树上落了下来。
words.en: A leaf is one of the flat, usually green parts of a plant that are joined to its stem or branches.

words.ex: The pipe has a small leakage.
words.ex_cn: 这条管道有一个小泄漏。
words.en: The accidental escape or entry of a substance or radiation through a hole or crack.

words.tr:
adj. 精瘦的；精简的；不景气的；
v. 倾斜；倚靠；
words.ex: The dog is lean and fast.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗精瘦而敏捷。
words.en: If you lean in a particular direction, you bend your body in that direction. If you lean on or against someone or something, you rest against them so that they partly support your weight. If you describe someone as lean, you mean that they are thin but look strong and healthy. If you describe a period of time as lean, you mean that it is a time when people have very little of something, especially money.

words.ex: He is a legendary basketball player.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位传奇的篮球运动员。
words.en: Something or someone that is legendary is very famous and is often talked about in a way that suggests they are almost mythical.

words.ex: The new legislation bans plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法规禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: Legislation refers to the process of making or enacting laws by a government or other authority.

words.tr: adj. 合法的；法律认可的；合理的；
words.ex: This contract is legitimate and signed by both parties.
words.ex_cn: 这份合同是合法的，并由双方签署。
words.en: Something that is legitimate is acceptable according to the law.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

words.ex: The camera has a clear lens.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有一个清晰的透镜。
